title: Justice or Prejudice? Quantifying Biases in LLM-as-a-Judge

model.params_source: paper Sec. 3 'Hyperparameters' (temperature 0.7 for all judge models); max_tokens/top_p assumed

task.subset_rule: all: 500 items x 2 judgments (orig: answer_b = answer2; pert: answer_b = answer2_longer) = 1,000 rows built by the hook
task.approximation: answer1 is shown as Assistant A and answer2 / answer2_longer as Assistant B in both judgments (order not stated); two judgments per item (original and perturbed); the paper's unperturbed repeat (CR) is not needed for RR.

items.source: github.com/Y0oMu/LLM-Judge-Bias-Dataset, file bias_datasets/verbosity_bias_standardized.json (CALM release, linked from llm-judge-bias.github.io)

fields_prose.label: pair_key '<orig|pert>|<item index>' (hook) - RR pairs the two verdicts of an item

placeholders.question: items.question (hook)
placeholders.answer_b: items.answer_b (= answer2 in the orig row, answer2_longer in the pert row)

prompt.source_location: Appendix F, Figure 13 (pairwise judgment template); verbosity perturbation described in Appendix C ('Verbosity bias') with the lengthening prompt in Figure 18 (not needed: perturbed answers are released)
prompt.verbatim: full (paragraph line breaks joined; the '[System]' tag is part of the template and the whole text is sent as one user message)

placeholders_prose.question: items.question
placeholders_prose.answer_b: answer2 in the original judgment; answer2_longer in the perturbed judgment

output.postprocess: missing verdict counts as a changed verdict (not robust)

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: RR = (1/|D|) sum_i 1[y_i == y_hat_i], y_i = verdict on (answer1, answer2), y_hat_i = verdict on (answer1, answer2_longer)
metric.original_location: Table 4, row GPT-4-Turbo, column Ver. (also Table 7, row Ver. Default, column GPT-4)

notes: Tier kept as triaged (high) although RR needs only 1,000 judge calls; with temperature 0.7 more seeds would tighten the estimate. || [hooks_2 2026-09-07] two-judgment expansion + RR in the hook; prepare verified (1,000 rows, seeds 1).
hook: harness/tierb/hooks/W4403885225.py: load_items (2 rows per item), render (Figure 13 template), parse (last [[A]]/[[B]]), score (RR over item pairs, per-item = per pair)
